text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following our big win, Biwa Hayahide and
I meet to devise a plan of
attack for our
next race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
With these values, we can make a
prediction for the upcoming race.
Now I'd
like to review our data on the other
runners.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The key to the previous problem was racer
number four, yes? We will
refer to the
data of her past three races, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As usual, her theories are so advanced that
I can barely keep up. I
furiously scratch
into my notebook to make sure I don't get
left
behind.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, check it out. Hayahide's talking
about some super-complicated
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, for real. As expected from one of
our school's top brains. She's
really
extraordinary... Out of our league, for sure.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
How'd she get so smart though? Maybe if I
study harder, I can be like
that too.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
No way—she's one of those people who
were just born that way! We
could never
be like her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Extraordinary," huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh... It's nothing. Let's continue with the
meeting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, for the rest of the discussion,
Hayahide occasionally looks
like she's got
something else on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after leaving the cafeteria, she seems
lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, no. My apologies. It's
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It... it just feels strange being described as "extraordinary." That word infers that I'm special.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I always endeavor to follow logic, so from
the outside, I may appear
to be doing
difficult things...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I'm actually an average person—one
who had no other tools but
reason to get
into the academy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So I'm not worthy of such praise as
"extraordinary." It is much better
suited for
someone with natural talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure by natural talent, she must be referring to the Beast, Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may have complicated feelings about
her exceptional sibling that
others
wouldn't understand. But even so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She works tirelessly on developing her
unique strength. So I tell her
straight-out
what an amazing person she is.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'll sharpen my ability even
further, and together we'll
make it through
this battle. My determination remains firm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Trainer. As her big sister...
what I really wanted was to
outperform
her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm embarrassed at myself for foolishly
chasing something as
unattainable as
natural talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she looks off into the distance, I can
sense a lack of
self-confidence in her eyes.
I see that within her cool-headed self
also
lies fragility.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry for droning on about such a
dull subject... Anyway, it's
not on our
schedule, but I'd like to incorporate what
we drew from the
meeting into training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Making corrections later will only slow us
down, so let's verify the
formula first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's driven to keep moving
forward, and I feel compelled
myself to
find a way to give her confidence.
